Read the documentation first.

Do not ask if the software is compatible with XYZ content extension. It only supports Joomla core content, as per the documentation, the software's description, and the README.

Please check the open _and closed_ Issues and Pull Requests tabs for similar issues.

Select the **support** issue type and fill in all the fields. Misfiled or partial reports may be closed as invalid.

Try to be accurate and descriptive when requesting support. We can't help if we can't understand what you're trying to do.

Kindly note that hostile or illegal behaviour will result in your issue being closed and locked, and possibly your account being banned from the entire `grafida` organisation on GitHub.
